title: Base Info Schema
description: Core fields shared across all entity types (products, models, providers, vendors, etc.)

name.description: The official name of the entity

description.description: A concise description of the entity and its key features, summarized from the official website homepage, company page, or about page

verified.description: Whether the entity has been reviewed by the AI Coding Stack team against cited sources. Legacy verified records may not yet include structured provenance.

deprecated.description: Whether the entity has been superseded or is no longer recommended for general use. Omit or set to false when no deprecation is recorded.

sources.description: Sources used to verify this entity or individual fields

lastVerifiedAt.description: Date when the cited facts were last reviewed (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD)

verifiedBy.description: GitHub handle or automation identifier responsible for the latest review

confidence.description: Overall confidence in the current record based on source quality and recency

fields.description: Manifest fields supported by this source; omit when it supports the whole record
